title: base-client: reject ws:// WebSocket URLs by default
description: Oracle: jmap-chat-wss-guide.md L401-402: "Clients MUST always connect to `wss://`, never `ws://`. The Session object's WebSocket URL will always be `wss://`; clients MUST reject any URL that does not begin with `wss://` rather than downgrading the connection." Same text in jmap-scene-wss-guide.md L666-667. Current: crate-jmap-base-client/src/ws/mod.rs L826-833 (connect_ws_with_limit) accepts ws or wss. ws:// is used by examples and testjig (JMAP-26di.29), so keep plaintext only behind an explicit opt-in (e.g. a ClientConfig flag or loopback-only), not by default. Source: JMAP-x3lu audit.
acceptance_criteria: connect_ws/connect_ws_with_limit return ClientError::InvalidArgument for a ws:// URL unless the caller opts in; wss:// unchanged; test asserts both; examples/testjig paths still work via the opt-in.
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
